objective: Extend the four-frame Match Grain jitter model with a fixed-reference, 240-frame characterization of displacement scale, frame-to-frame change, wrap coverage, and output-resolution dependence across temporalJitter controls.

scope.effect: ArtifactMatchGrainEffect source equations for the named-reference Gaussian residual and frame-hash integer cyclic shift
scope.method: Independent Python/NumPy/OpenCV model from the inspected source. Use a deterministic synthetic multi-scale RGB reference and measure its Gaussian high-frequency residual after fixed resolution preparation.
included: source hash and float-to-int displacement equation
continuous adjacent-frame displacement and residual change
cyclic wrap coverage and static-source residual
excluded: named-input sampler routing and reference import metadata
actual playback clock, frame dropping, seek/reverse behavior

comparison.baseline: Same deterministic reference residual with temporalJitter=0, which should produce zero displacement and identical residual field on every frame.
candidates: temporalJitter .05, .1, .25, .5, and 1 at both output sizes; grainSize=1.15 and frame keys 0..239
comparison.ground_truth: None. The synthetic reference is a diagnostic texture, not a real film scan or approved temporal appearance target.
comparison.acceptance: Descriptive source-model study only. Check exact source markers, deterministic regeneration, zero-jitter identity, periodic wrap equivalence, finite outputs, and report frame-to-frame displacement/residual statistics. No temporal quality pass threshold or product verdict.

materials.fixture: Script-generated fixed 3-channel Float32 reference based on the same deterministic multiscale texture construction as match-grain-reference-transfer-r1; alpha opaque and unused by residual extraction.
materials.rights: Locally generated synthetic material; no external assets.
materials.identity: Metrics record source, plan, runner, reference residual and output checksums, dimensions, seed and libraries.

regions.whole_frame: All pixels of the synthetic residual field.
regions.wrap_area: Analytic fraction of output coordinates whose x or y lookup crosses a frame boundary after cyclic shifting.

conditions.frame_rate_for_duration_interpretation: 24 fps (10 seconds); source equation uses integer composition-frame key only.
metrics: jitter x/y min, max, median absolute, p95 absolute, unique offset count
adjacent-frame displacement vector distribution in pixels and as a fraction of the frame diagonal, plus zero-step rate
adjacent residual luma correlation and delta RMSE
predicted cyclic wrap coverage per frame
finite-value count and residual/output range statistics
conditions.display: Contact sheet of mean-centered luma residuals for frames 0,1,2,3 at all temporalJitter values and 512x256; common fixed 4x residual gain. Metrics use Float32 arrays before display conversion.

effect_correctness.method: Match the uint32 creativeHash and C++ float32 arithmetic / truncation-toward-zero / modulo-wrapped coordinate lookup; compare source markers and exact zero-jitter identity.
effect_correctness.acceptance_criteria: All markers true; deterministic offsets; zero jitter gives zero offset and identical field; known-offset reverse alignment returns the same source field within Float32 tolerance.

image_quality_and_detail.method: Inspect the contact sheet and residual plots at native and enlarged scales; report motion of reference texture only.
image_quality_and_detail.acceptance_criteria: No aesthetic pass/fail, no claim that grain motion is undesirable.

color_and_alpha.method: Use luma projection of RGB residual for temporal statistics.
color_and_alpha.unverified: Colored source response, alpha association, reference descriptors and compositing.

temporal_stability.method: Measure per-frame shifts and aligned/unaligned residual change for 240 static-source frames.
temporal_stability.unverified: Playback scheduling, real-time frame cadence, motion interaction, seek/reverse, viewer perception.

render_paths_and_resolution.unverified: Compiled runtime, actual named input, preview/final output and GPU/backend behavior.

performance.reason: No product runtime or allocation profiling.

evaluation.decision: No effect quality acceptance, preferred jitter setting, or product integration decision.

execution.backend: Python 3, NumPy, OpenCV, Pillow; offline equation model only.
execution.threshold_policy: Only exact model invariants use tolerances; no temporal-quality threshold.
execution.reproducibility: Fixed synthetic reference seed, source hash, frame range, dimensions, settings, library versions and SHA-256 manifest.

amendments.reason: The first report exposed a normalized-axis Euclidean step measure that could be misread as a fraction of the pixel-space frame diagonal.
amendments.change: Report physical pixel displacement and an explicit pixel-space frame-diagonal fraction alongside the normalized-axis measure.
amendments.scope_effect: Adds a clearly defined descriptive statistic; conditions, candidates, acceptance criteria, and prior results are unchanged. Regenerate the complete report.
